categories.name: Highscore
categories.rules:
Reach this distance as fast as possible!

Video proof is needed for everything other than highscore, for highscore a picture is fine.

If you can use a timer, add it!

For all categories time starts the first frame your character is visible, though you still need to show yourself hitting play,either in the main menu or in the pause menu.

A video proof with sound is needed for all categories except highscore! ( A screen is ok for highscore )

50m :
You have to reach 50m as fast as possible! All vehicles are allowed !

100m :
You have to reach 100m as fast as possible! All vehicles are allowed

!200m :
You have to reach 200m as fast as possible! All vehicles are allowed

500m :
You have to reach 500m as fast as possible! All vehicles are allowed

1000m :
You have to reach 1000m as fast as possible! All vehicles are allowed !

Death :
You have to die as fast as possible ! Timer starts whent the first frame your character is visible and ends when the photo of your death pops up.

Collect a diamond :
You have to collect a diamond as fast as possible! Time starts the first frame your character is visible and ends when 1 diamond is added to your diamond count during the game.

Collect fuel :
You have to collect fuel as fast as possible ( its the red box ) ! time starts the first frame your character is visible and ends when your fuel count goes up after collecting it.

Collect coins !
Collect a coin with the number required as fast as possible ! Time starts the first frame your character is visible and ends once the given amount of coins has been added to your coin count since the beginning of the run

Back flip, flip, neck flip :
You have to do a flip or a back flip or a neck flip as fast as possible ! Time starts the first frame your character is visible and ends when "back flip" or "flip" or "neck flip" appear on the screen !
If you have any question, ask in forum!
If you can add a timer, add it !
